name: Pup
status: Nordic nRF52840 Dongle (PCA10059), pins from Nordic's documentation for it; a test board for the wireless outputs until the Dachshund60F PCB exists

usb.warning: pid.codes TEST PID, the same as the Dachshund60F's: in-house testing only.

matrix.note: SW1 to ground, read straight from its pin: no columns (firmware/src/matrix.h)

indicators.type: LD2, RGB LED, common anode on VDD; each colour on or off

power.supply: USB only: the dongle plugs straight into a port and has no battery

reserved.P0.18: nRESET (SW2, the sideways reset button, which also enters Nordic's bootloader)
